caption: The drawing features a rectangular pattern composed of a grid of horizontal and vertical lines filled with repetitive geometric shapes resembling woven textile. The main section is divided into several smaller rectangular and square segments, each filled with different arrangements of lines and ovals, combined in a way that creates a checkered effect. The color palette in the drawing consists primarily of red, blue, and beige, with red and blue alternating in the forms, and the background left uncolored, creating contrast with the filled polygons. The background of the paper is a light beige or off-white color, and there is a small handwritten signature in the lower right corner of the drawing area. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the colored pattern centrally positioned on the sheet and surrounded by large empty margins.
title: Coverlet (Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
